Owner: Honey School platform maintainers. Gradle dependency-management-plugin is misidentified as Spring Framework 1.1.7; the artifact contains no org/springframework classes. Evidence: https://github.com/spring-gradle-plugins/dependency-management-plugin/tree/v1.1.7 . This excludes only the observed Spring Framework CVEs on this exact plugin version.
Owner: Honey School platform maintainers. Spring Tools IDE YAML editors are a different product from Spring Boot loader tools. https://spring.io/security/cve-2022-31691/
